title: OLEANDER Interior Design Process v1.0 — Candidate
purpose: Run authentic interior-design development from strategic appointment and briefing through concept, spatial and technical design, procurement/construction administration, handover and post-occupancy evaluation while preserving human-use, material/product, FF&E, procurement and cross-disciplinary responsibility boundaries.
scope_in: interior spatial experience and room planning
partitions, ceilings, floors, wall systems and finishes
fixed joinery and custom interior elements
mockups, specialist submittals and construction administration
authority_position: Candidate R-E professional-domain process subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Knowledge Authority, Professional Domain Process Contract, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project/jurisdiction/appointment authority and responsible Interior Design professional. Current Architecture Map remains OPEN for Interior Design until explicit promotion.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires professional interior spatial, material, FF&E, technical, procurement, construction or in-use judgment.
responsibility_triggers: interior design decision controls another discipline or procurement package
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable current claim ceiling across appointment scope, mounted knowledge/product evidence, interface maturity, native interior evidence, mockup/site evidence and external statutory/professional authority governs.
not_triggered_when: decorative reference imagery with explicit exclusion of professional interior-design claims
mandatory_reopen_triggers: site nonconformity or field dimension change
post-occupancy evidence materially contradicts design assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential user, material/product, accessibility, fire, lighting, acoustic, MEP, procurement and field evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional interior decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER design-quality and material/product routing
site observation and closeout readback when claimed
source_routes: BIID guidance on RIBA Plan of Work and Interior Designers
current applicable interior material/product and building requirements
CIDQ 2026-and-forward IDFX / IDIX / IDPX professional task evidence
CIDQ current Practice Analysis / Job Task Analysis evidence
current ASID commercial-contract scope evidence for interior construction, FF&E, project administration and purchasing
standard_code_routes: jurisdiction-specific interior, accessibility, fire, material, health and safety requirements
precedent_case_routes: bounded interior precedents where applicability is established
tool_knowledge_routes: current CAD/BIM, schedule, material and visualization execution guidance when used

render does not replace dimensional/detail readback
tool_adapter_requirements: Current Skill Resolver selects current capabilities/tools; no hardcoded global inventory
actual_readback_requirements: actual use evidence for POE claims

release_control_objects: Submittal / Sample / Mockup / Substitution Release Register

does_not_require: same stage count as other domains

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Translate users, activities, brand/experience, operational, accessibility and life-safety dependencies into room/interior design judgments.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current project brief + user/operation evidence + Architecture room/space authority.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Retain only where consequential activity/equipment/interface requirements are explicit; mood imagery cannot substitute for functional/performance brief.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent interior review must attack representative high-use/high-risk rooms and the strongest functional-aesthetic conflict.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interior Material / Product / Sample Evidence & Assumption Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Keep finish, substrate, fire/slip/toxicity/durability/cleaning, product availability and sample assumptions traceable.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Manufacturer/product evidence + project performance requirements + sample/mockup evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: No finish/product may be treated approved from image/name only; consequential performance evidence and substrate/interface conditions remain explicit.
failure_or_hold_conditions: render texture used as product evidence
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist review where product performance affects health/safety/accessibility or contractual acceptance.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interior Concept / Room Strategy / FF&E Option Set
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Compare materially different spatial, FF&E, material, joinery and experience strategies before technical lock.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Matched-fidelity interior plans/sections/elevations/FF&E and material strategy artifacts.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: option_id + common room/brief baseline + option artifact revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Do not count colour/material variants alone as concept families; compare use, circulation, storage, service, maintenance and procurement consequences.
failure_or_hold_conditions: same layout with palette changes called alternatives
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent review must challenge the selected concept against strongest rejected spatial/material strategy.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Controlled Interior Room / RCP / Elevation / Finish / Joinery / FF&E Package
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Carry the actual interior design in coordinated editable room plans, RCPs, elevations, details, schedules and specifications.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Owner-native CAD/BIM/vector/model/schedule/specification sources designated Current for interior scope.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Room plan/RCP/elevation/detail/schedule/spec must remain coordinated; presentation boards cannot replace production sources.
failure_or_hold_conditions: joinery detail not reflected in plan/elevation
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent interior QA/QC on exact package/revision, sampling critical rooms/details/interfaces.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interior Submittal / Sample / Mockup / Procurement Release Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Control release of finishes, furniture, joinery, doors/hardware, mockups and substitutions against design/performance/coordination requirements.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current interior package + submitted product/shop drawing/sample/mockup/procurement evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: release_id + design requirement revision + submitted/sample revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Release applies to exact submitted identity and reviewed attributes; visual similarity alone never establishes equivalence.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Distinct specialist review where fire, accessibility, electrical, structural or other specialist performance is material.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interior Site QA / RFI / Defect / Installation Record
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Bind site conditions, installation, defects, RFIs and accepted changes to exact interior design/source items.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Site observation + installed product identity + current issued interior information.
practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: field_item_id + space/location + issue revision + observation date
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Observation is bounded to observed scope; material site changes require source/schedule/detail update and recoordination.
failure_or_hold_conditions: photo used as universal site PASS
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist witness where critical mockup, safety/performance or contractual acceptance requires it.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interior Closeout / Asset / Warranty / POE Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Transfer installed identities, warranties, maintenance and open defects, then bind post-occupancy observations to the actual room/configuration.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Accepted installed/record information + asset/warranty/O&M + bounded POE evidence.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Installed/accepted condition remains distinct from mature use satisfaction; POE findings remain room/user/time bounded.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent closeout/POE review where project scope/risk requires.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interior QA/QC / Independent Professional Review Record
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Attack room usability, plan/RCP/elevation/detail consistency, finish/product evidence and site release on exact revisions.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Review expires for affected scope after material room/RCP/detail/product/site change.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Reviewer independence and specialist participation proportionate to safety/interface/procurement consequence.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Interior Change / Schedule / Procurement Impact Ledger
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Propagate room, finish, RCP, joinery, FF&E, door/hardware, procurement and site changes across all affected native objects and reviews.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Controlled change/RFI/substitution event + dependency links across interior package/schedules/releases.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Change closes only after affected drawings/schedules/specs/procurement/interface/review records are updated or explicitly retained.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent re-review when change affects prior critical QA/QC or specialist evidence.

assurance.professional_review: Interior professional review at the current stage/claim ceiling, separate from pure visual preference.
assurance.evidence_review: Check user/room, product/material, specialist, procurement, sample/mockup, site and POE evidence against claimed use.
technical_gates: site/handover gate when field claims are made
RCP/service coordination gate when ceiling/service claims are material
product/material evidence gate for consequential finish/FF&E claims
field/submittal/closeout evidence gate when construction/handover claims are made
assurance.independent_review: Required where risk, safety/interface consequence, procurement conflict, complexity or stage demands a distinct reviewer; producer self-check alone does not satisfy independence.
assurance.receipt_contract: Professional receipt records stage/process verdict, claim ceiling, appointment/scope, native/readback refs, product/sample/site evidence, open items and does-not-prove boundary.

stale_scope_rules: invalidate only affected room/detail/product/interface/procurement/site evidence unless dependencies show wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: changed Architecture/MEP/Fire/Accessibility/Lighting/Acoustic/product evidence propagates to consuming interior stages
downstream_impact_rules: changed room/partition/FF&E/material/detail/procurement variables propagate to consuming professions, suppliers and FM
interface_reopen_rules: reopen affected Integration interfaces when shared variables/acceptance criteria change
receipt_stale_rules: professional receipt becomes stale at affected scope when appointment, native design, product identity, sample benchmark, site or evidence basis changes

process_exit_conditions: all triggered interior stages close at declared current claim ceiling
open items are explicit later/outside claim and non-contradictory
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim specialist, procurement, defect or POE items that do not contradict current professional verdict
completion_contract.promotion_effect: A current professional PASS may satisfy only the bounded Interior professional-process dependency; it does not grant statutory approval, field validity, Design KEEP or Promotion.
